text:
Sam: hey team, new hire on Win11 + WSL2 (Ubuntu). following the quickstart but asdf shims aren't being used by VSCode tasks. `which asdf` -> /home/sam/.asdf/bin/asdf and `asdf which node` -> ~/.asdf/shims/node, but task runner still picks /usr/bin/node. opened VSCode from Start menu. any quick tips?
Nina: welcome! :wave: open VSCode from the WSL shell with `code .` so the Remote - WSL extension attaches. also make sure you source asdf in your shell init (eg `~/.profile` or `~/.bashrc`) and restart the shell.
Sam: i tried `code .` but tasks still use system node when invoked via the Run Task palette (not the integrated terminal).
Nina: tasks don't always run as a login shell. set the workspace setting `
